- [EVENT] User recently made Korean-style BBQ beef short ribs using a recipe found online.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Provided recommendations for a Korean-style BBQ marinade, including essential and optional ingredients:
  - Essential Ingredients: Gochujang, soy sauce, garlic, ginger, brown sugar, sesame oil, crushed black pepper.
  - Optional Ingredients: Korean chili flakes, pineapple juice or Korean pear juice, green onions, cumin.
- [ASSISTANT_CREATED] Provided a basic marinade recipe with specific measurements:
  - 1/2 cup soy sauce
  - 1/4 cup gochujang
  - 2 cloves garlic, minced and sautéed
  - 1 inch ginger, grated and sautéed
  - 2 tablespoons brown sugar
  - 1 tablespoon sesame oil
  - 1 teaspoon crushed black pepper
  - 1/4 teaspoon Korean chili flakes (optional)
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested marinating time of at least 2 hours or overnight for maximum flavor penetration.
